patch.value: Build the real-Postgres route harness and cover the pm-web access-control surface

Stage 1 of pm-web-9ulj. Replace the ad-hoc 'as any' pool.query stubs with a reusable harness that starts the real Express app from createApp() on an ephemeral port, points the module-level pg pool at a throwaway PostgreSQL via DATABASE_URL supplied by the test runner (the pool is constructed at import time, so the runner must set it, not the test body), and seeds state through the shipped idempotent initSchema(). Cover the security-critical routers: sharing.ts (201 lines, 0% functions), groups.ts (232, 0%), admin.ts (229, 0%), auth.ts (171, 0%), projects.ts (193, 16.67%) and oidc.ts (199, 22.22%). Every ownership and permission branch needs both its allow and its deny assertion, because the deny path is the one that regressed before.

The harness sets no pool.query stub and introduces no 'as any'; sharing, groups, admin, auth, projects and oidc routers each reach full function coverage with allow-and-deny assertions per ownership branch; tests fail loudly rather than skipping when the database is unreachable; npm run check passes

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Branch coverage restored above the 80 floor after the PR #74 malformed-UUID 400 fix moved defensive catch branches out of reach. Package branches 79.46% -> 81.08% (all 256 tests pass; npm run check + npm run coverage both exit 0). Covered genuine, reachable branches in a new test/pure-units.test.ts (no DB, real Express probe app): routeParam array-collapse + missing->'' ; isUuid shape; requireUuidParams reject/skip-absent; uuidParamGuard 400/200; extractToken header>cookie>query>none precedence; verifyToken round-trip + tampered reject; requireAuth 401 catch on a tampered token; crypto encrypt/decrypt round-trip, null, legacy-plaintext, malformed-envelope, short-secret throw; assertDbConfigured DATABASE_URL / POSTGRES_HOST+DB / throw paths. Plus targeted route tests: projects PATCH description-only (covers name-omitted null + description-value arms), auth PATCH /profile clears display name, extensions install-failure (400 carries pm stderr) and healthy GET (no stateError). Per-file branches: crypto 80->100, middleware/auth 80->100, route-params 87.5->100, auth 66.7->87.5, db 40->66.7, routes/auth 79.1->81.4, projects 78.1->81.4, extensions 63.2->66.7. LEFT UNREACHABLE (per task guidance, not faked): every handler's DB-outage catch in admin/projects/sharing/groups/routes-auth (only a connection drop triggers them); projects.ts initProject rollback (needs a simulated pm-runner failure); extensions activate/deactivate/uninstall handler bodies (run through the in-process pm SDK, not the fake-pm spawn, so not fast-isolated); pm-runner spawn-failure paths; oidc flows; pm.ts/index.ts/server.ts (stage 2 / forbidden). Thresholds updated to floor(measured)-1 clamped to the existing floor: lines 60, branches 80, functions 56->57 (measured lines 61.36 / branches 81.08 / functions 58.18).
